text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whewie! That was some tasty grub!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for chill'n the watermelon! It
really hit the
spot!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Will do! And I'll be sure to tell 'em all
you went
gaga for this melon!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well, now that we've eaten watermelon
and
trained a whole bunch, that means
I've done
everyth'n on my list!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Do y'think I've gotten any stronger?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: If so, the Shuka Sho should be a cinch!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Let's hop on the bus, then.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hi, Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: City! I didn't know you were here too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't able to stay the whole time
because of
work, but camp is a great
time to cram in a lot of
training in a short
amount of time.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Are you say'n what I think you're say'n?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Are you gett'n ready for a big race?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City isn't currently signed up for
any major
races. It's only natural that
Yukino Bijin would
assume she was,
but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I don't have a race or anything. I
just don't
want to lose my edge.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah, whoops... sorry for jump'n the gun.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm a big fan of yours, so I can't help
gett'n
excited at the thought of you
compet'n in a race!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: The way you run is just so... dazzl'n!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sorry for getting your hopes up.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, not at all! What're you apologiz'n
for?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who jumped to conclusions.
I'm sure
you've got reasons for not
runn'n. You're prob'ly
real busy with
work 'n stuff!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Reasons? Not really. I'm just running
away...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: City?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hey. If you ever feel like you're about to
get
crushed by pressure...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Just remember to take lots of deep
breaths,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Crushed?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Never mind. Forget I said anything.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Good luck at the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: R-right! Thanks bunches!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
City's so nice... She's always encourag'n
me and
giv'n me advice.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I've gotta do my best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, summer camp comes to a
close.
